name: g-couch
prompt: Candid photo on a Sunday morning at home: a Latina woman in her thirties with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, a soft oatmeal sweater and reading glasses sits cross-legged on a linen sofa with a silver MacBook Pro on her lap, a mug of coffee in one hand, smiling slightly as she reads. Camera is beside and slightly behind her so the laptop screen is clearly visible at an angle. The laptop display is a flat, evenly lit, solid pure chroma green (#00FF00) rectangle filling the whole screen area inside the bezel, no reflections. Bright living room, plants, morning sun, 35mm, shallow depth of field, realistic. No logos.
